column1: # slug|impact,uniqueness,significance,experience,depth|category overrides or -|individual rationale

huai-kha-khaeng-wildlife-sanctuary|9.1,9.5,9.5,8.2,8.3|-|Ecological importance is outstanding; restricted and specialized wildlife encounters cannot be equated with a deep conventional sightseeing visit.
cheow-lan-lake|9.1,9.3,8.5,9.3,8.7|-|Spectacular Khao Sok reservoir and karst scenery, but man-made lake significance and area depth should not match the whole national park.
khao-sok-national-park|9.4,9.4,9.1,9.4,9.3|-|World-class rainforest and limestone scenery, but avoid treating a national park as rare on all dimensions just because landscape is spectacular.
phang-nga-bay|9.4,9.4,8.9,9.3,9.1|-|Striking karst seascape with meaningful exploration, though Ha Long Bay has greater scale and global natural significance.
kaeng-krachan-national-park|9.0,9.2,9.1,8.8,8.9|-|Critical rainforest habitat, while wildlife viewing experience and structured discovery are more variable than biological importance.
khao-yai-national-park|9.0,9.1,9.0,9.0,9.2|-|Major protected landscape and safari-like opportunities, but do not borrow ecological importance entirely into visitor immersion.
hellfire-pass-memorial|8.7,9.0,9.5,8.8,8.1|-|Somber railway history and powerful interpretation; a short memorial walking trail has limited breadth relative to museum ensembles.
wat-phra-mahathat-woramahawihan|8.7,8.9,9.2,8.8,8.2|-|Important active Buddhist religious complex, but the visitor experience is not on the scale of Angkor Wat or the Grand Palace.
phanom-rung-historical-park|9.0,9.4,9.4,9.0,8.6|-|Exceptional Khmer hilltop sanctuary; one temple complex should not inherit the breadth of the Angkor Archaeological Park.
si-thep-historical-park|8.9,9.2,9.4,8.9,8.6|-|Important Dvaravati archaeological landscape, with preservation and on-site depth below the top restored monumental ensembles.
si-satchanalai-historical-park|8.9,9.0,9.3,8.9,8.8|-|Rich Sukhothai-era ruins, but less exceptional multi-site exploration than Ayutthaya or Sukhothai headline parks.
wat-rong-khun-white-temple|8.6,9.1,8.4,8.7,7.6|-|Striking modern artistic temple, whose visual distinctiveness should not be confused with centuries of global historical importance.
maya-bay|8.8,9.1,7.3,8.9,7.4|-|Iconic bay scenery but short visit and relatively replaceable natural significance within global tropical-beach peers.
railay-beach|8.9,9.0,7.5,9.2,8.3|-|Excellent limestone beach and climbing setting; national scenic fame does not imply extraordinary worldwide historical significance.
koh-kradan|8.8,8.9,7.4,9.0,8.4|-|High-quality island beaches but much lower global ecological and historical significance than marine national parks.
similan-islands|9.1,9.3,8.5,9.2,8.9|-|Superb diving islands, but biodiversity and reef experiences should be distinguished from global natural-science uniqueness.
surin-islands|9.0,9.3,8.5,9.2,8.9|-|Marine biodiversity and diving excel, without treating every island group as uniquely world defining.
grand-palace|9.3,9.2,9.5,9.3,9.1|-|Grand Palace is exceptional cultural heritage; individual sections and palaces should not automatically all score near perfect.
wat-pho|9.0,9.2,9.3,9.2,8.5|-|Major temple and reclining Buddha, but one complex does not have the breadth of an entire historic city.

ang-thong-national-marine-park|9.0,9.0,8.6,9.1,8.9|-|The 42-island protected Gulf archipelago offers worthwhile kayaking, overlooks and beaches but is less globally singular and deep than Ha Long Bay; reduce excess environmental significance and visit depth. Source: https://www.thailandtourismdirectory.go.th/en/attraction/2136

ayutthaya-historical-park|9.6,9.5,9.8,9.4,9.5|-|Retain extensive historic royal capital whose surviving monuments have substantive national and world historical impact; distinct from a single Wat ruin. Source: https://whc.unesco.org/en/list/576/

ko-phi-phi-leh|9.0,9.1,8.2,9.1,8.3|-|Exceptional iconic limestone island scenery but a constrained island excursion, not an ecosystem-wide national park experience or unique world heritage archipelago; reduce depth/uniqueness and visitor blanket score. Source: https://www.tourismthailand.org/

sukhothai-historical-park|9.4,9.6,9.8,9.5,9.5|-|Retain heritage significance for Sukhothai core park and monuments of a foundational Thai capital, preserving UNESCO comparison with Ayutthaya without inheriting unrelated towns. Source: https://whc.unesco.org/en/list/574

wat-arun|8.9,9.0,8.9,9.1,8.0|-|Highly photogenic Bangkok riverside temple with striking spires, but compact on-site visit and architecture should not inherit entire capital-city heritage significance or breadth of Wat Phra Kaew. Source: https://www.tourismthailand.org/Attraction/wat-arun-ratchawararam-ratchawaramahawihan

wat-phra-kaew|9.4,9.6,9.8,9.4,8.9|-|Retain extraordinary Bangkok royal temple with Emerald Buddha and sophisticated sacred architecture; distinguish temple footprint from the larger Grand Palace grounds. Source: https://www.royalgrandpalace.th/en/discover/history/
